blocks.text:
**Business visits are agreed before booking.** This programme is available on request: the event name and dates in Ribeirão Preto require confirmation. IFAMA 2027 will take place in Lima, Peru, so attendance at that conference in Ribeirão Preto is not included in this trip.

Your journey begins in São Paulo, with its business districts and historic centre, then continues to Ribeirão Preto. After the professional programme, the scenery changes completely: Amazonian rivers and jungle lodges, Rio’s ocean panoramas, and the Brazilian and Argentine cascades of Iguazu. You return to São Paulo for your flight home.

## Price and accommodation

The price is calculated on request. The itinerary lasts 14 days and 13 nights. Hotels, room categories, flights and the business programme are selected for your trip.
